title: Mo jarribo ndiyam yaltini
intro: E nder defte binndaaɗe ɓooyɗe, ina woodi limre teskinnde, nde daartol mum fuɗɗotoo wonaa e kaawisaaji teskinɗi walla e peeñgol ɓuuɓngol, kono ko e jarribo goonɗinal koyngal, kono luggiɗngal. Leñol darii e ŋoral, ina ɗaɓɓa ardorde Alla ngam ardaade. Ko 6eydi heen ko jarribo 6urngo hakkilantaagal haa feeñnina googcfin6e goonga e nder ma66e. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade ndee sirlu e nate heddiiɗe ɗee?
clues: Mi ummii ko e leñol ngol yimɓe ɓee njiɗi, Alla suɓii kam ko e faandaare ceniinde nde ɓe mbaawaa faamde.
Ɓanndu am ina joginoo maande ceertunde nde woɗɓe ngalaa, ina addana mi daraade e nder leñol am.
Nde maayo ngoo anndinaa jarribo, ko ɓuri heewde e maɓɓe ngartii caggal—kono miɗo ƴattoroo yeeso, miɗo diwta goonɗinal ngal aldaa e paltoor e fodoore Alla.
Mi yamiraama mi waasa yarde ndiyam harminaaɗam, kono toɓɓere wootere daɗii e hunuko am – bakkaat gonɗo e ɓernde am haa abada.
Alla fotnoo ko hawrude e gaynaako tokooso mo ñalnde heen wontata legendaire ngam warde gaño mawɗo.
Nde konuuli ɗii ndartini, mi fadaani e junngo gaño, kono ko e yamiroore Alla ngam ñaawde majjere am to maayo.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
